question: Could you calculate the average of the total runs scored by all strikers who have scored more than 50 runs in any single match?
sql:
WITH striker_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.striker,
        bs.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as match_total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL
      AND bs.runs_scored IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.striker, bs.match_id
),
strikers_with_high_score AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT striker
    FROM striker_match_runs
    WHERE match_total_runs > 50
),
striker_total_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        s.striker,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    JOIN strikers_with_high_score s ON b.striker = s.striker
    WHERE bs.runs_scored IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.striker
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) as average_total_runs
FROM striker_total_runs;
